text:
DeepInfer

DeepInfer is the high-performance inference framework that powers DeepSeek's large-scale production services. This open-source release provides offline inference with the core features needed for serving at scale.

Supported models:

- DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash

Supported features:

- Optimized kernels, model and sampler runtime
- Parallelism: Attention DP / balanced CP, MoE EP + EPLB
- DSpark and confidence-scheduled verification
- SWA bounded replay
- Asynchronous scheduling (zero-overhead batch scheduler)
- Batch-invariant inference
- Deterministic sampling
- Structured outputs

 
 Feature details and configuration 

- Optimized kernels: FlashMLA, DeepGEMM, DeepEP, TileKernels, DeepSelect, and custom TileLang kernels.
- DSpark and confidence-scheduled verification: accelerate decoding with draft tokens and use confidence estimates to schedule verification. Set DEEPINFER ENABLE MTP VARLEN=1 ; DEEPINFER USE NEXTN DECODE controls the maximum draft length (default: 5).
- Decoder SWA bounded replay: reduce decoder prefill work by replaying only a bounded suffix. Set DEEPINFER YOCO PREFILL TRUNCATION MODE=compact and DEEPINFER YOCO PREFILL KEEP TOKENS=140 for the default V4.1 settings; the retained suffix must cover the SWA window plus the maximum backtracking length.
- Asynchronous scheduling: overlap CPU batch scheduling with device execution. Enabled by default.
- Batch-invariant inference: keep model results identical across different batch compositions. Enable with DEEPINFER BATCH INVARIANT=1 (NVIDIA only).
- Deterministic sampling: produce identical outputs for identical input tokens and sampling parameters. Set DEEPINFER BATCH INVARIANT=1 DEEPINFER ENABLE MTP VARLEN=0 and pass a fixed seq seed to SamplingParams (NVIDIA only).
- Structured outputs: constrain generation to a regex, JSON schema, or EBNF grammar. Pass so args={"schema type": ..., "schema": ...} to SamplingParams ; see examples.

 

Supported hardware:

- NVIDIA SM100 GPUs
- Huawei Ascend 950 NPUs

Required for a complete inference service (not included in this release):

- A KV cache system
- VE/Prefill/Decode disaggregation (most required engine functionality is already implemented)
- Load balancing across data-parallel replicas for both prefill and decode

 Getting started

 Prerequisites

- Linux
- GCC = 13.0
- Python 3.12
- CUDA 13 (NVIDIA only)
- CANN 9.2 (Ascend only)

 Build from source

Before building DeepInfer, please create and activate an empty Python 3.12 environment.

 

 Offline inference

The default checkpoint, deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017 , is
downloaded into the Hugging Face cache on the first run; set DEEPINFER HF MODEL DIR=/path/to/DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017 to
run from a local copy instead.

 

See examples for details.

 Performance benchmarks

 Prefill Decode 
 :---: :---: 
 

Measured on 4 SM100 GPUs for prefill and 64 for decode — each within one scale-up domain. To reproduce the benchmarks, see run sweep.sh.

 Evaluation benchmarks

See eval/README.md.

 License

DeepInfer is released under the Apache License 2.0. See LICENSE for details.

 Acknowledgments

DeepInfer was originally built primarily on vLLM, with additional inspiration from SGLang and TensorRT-LLM. We thank their developers.

install.html:
Prerequisites
  • Linux
  • GCC >= 13.0
  • Python 3.12
  • CUDA 13 (NVIDIA only)
  • CANN 9.2 (Ascend only)
Build from source

Before building DeepInfer, please create and activate an empty Python 3.12 environment.

# Use `ascend` instead for the Ascend platform
# Keep it exported in the environment where you run DeepInfer
export DEEPINFER_ACCELERATOR=nvidia
./build.sh
Offline inference

The default checkpoint, deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017, is downloaded into the Hugging Face cache on the first run; set DEEPINFER_HF_MODEL_DIR=/path/to/DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017 to run from a local copy instead.

python examples/offline_inference.py

See examples for details.
